readings.moment: The temple struck ten while Girard was still in the dining room (he confirms hearing it).
Girard went out into the street.
The piano started up in the salon as Girard lit his cigar.
Girard heard faint quick bells from the master's window while the piano was playing.
Girard came back into the house.
The hall clock had just struck eleven as Girard came back in.
The face of the hall clock showed two minutes past eleven when Girard looked at it.

durations: The piano played from 10:29 to 10:42, about 13 minutes (implied by the start and stop readings on Girard's watch).
Girard was in the street from 10:21 to 10:46, about 25 minutes (implied by his going out and coming back in, by his watch).
whereabouts: Girard came to dinner at Monnier's invitation.
Girard quarrelled with Monnier about the price of the movement at the dinner table.
At nine, Monnier had the company show their watches; Girard was present and kept his own in his pocket.
After dinner Girard sat alone in the dining room with the brandy.
Girard was in the dining room when the temple struck ten.
Girard went out into the street at 10:21 and stayed under the front windows of the house.
Girard was in the street when the piano started and when the bells were heard; he could not see who was playing.
Girard came back into the house at 10:46.
Girard went upstairs to Félix in the library.
Girard did not play cards with Dr Vauthier this evening.
